paper_id: Learning to Immunize Images for Tamper Localization and Self-Recovery
title: Learning to Immunize Images for Tamper Localization and Self-Recovery
motivation: Digital images在OSN平台易被恶意篡改,而现有被动取证无法自恢复内容,作者提出免疫概念让图像主动抵抗攻击
problem_framing: 将图像免疫与自恢复建模为可逆函数对,利用INN在单网络中同时学习嵌入与恢复;通过KD-JPEG蒸馏解决JPEG压缩下的鲁棒性
key_insight: 观察图像免疫与自恢复间的可逆性关系,采用归一化流生成器在单网络中联合学习 immunization 和 recovery
method_signature: IINet(可逆U-net)+KD-JPEG(JPEG模拟器)+伪造检测器+双判别器
evaluation_criteria: 篡改定位精度MIoU + 恢复图像质量PSNR/SSIM + 与被动取证SOTA对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Imuge仅能近似恢复原始内容,与ground truth仍有较大差距;Imuge定位精度不理想且无法抵抗inpainting攻击
evidence_for_taste: the network will tend to hallucinate the missing content
minimizing L can hardly achieve satisfying results
poorly-trained forgery detector will mislead the image recovery process
still a big gap toward high-quality and accurate image recovery
thinking_moves: 从Imuge的失败案例(模糊恢复/定位不准)反推其根本缺陷是网络会依赖DIP幻觉内容而非忠实恢复
将图像免疫问题重新frame为可逆变换问题,用INN的固有性质同时实现嵌入与恢复
针对JPEG鲁棒性差的问题,提出用知识蒸馏训练学生网络模拟真实JPEG压缩的量化表变化
提出tampering-based data augmentation强制网络不依赖Deep Image Prior进行恢复
cites_own_work: Imuge conference paper [74] is the precursor - Imuge+ extends it
